summary: A Felucca-based firmware aimed at dungeon synth, dark ambient and medieval fantasy music, with its own sounds, scenes, tunings and a generative composer.
features: Keeps Felucca's four-track sequencer, song mode, effects and editor
GURDY hurdy-gurdy engine, with the SELECT knob usable as a crank
"DREAM" writes and evolves a slow piece across all four tracks
59 curated sounds, CRYPT drum kit, HALL reverb, tape and cave ambience
Pythagorean, meantone and just tunings; layer, split and drone latch
MIDI CC control and sequencer output over USB MIDI; runs in a browser

headings: if the fm-1 does not start
